title: set_tips DELETE + INSERT loop does not scale with tip count
description: O(T) STATEMENTS IN TRANSACTION — set_tips (sqlite_storage.rs:166) first deletes all tips for a group then re-inserts each tip individually in a loop within one transaction. This is used by reconcile to overwrite the tip set after merging. With T concurrent-branch tips (worst case during a large CRDT reconciliation), this is T INSERT statements. Fix: use executemany / a bulk INSERT VALUES (?,?), (?,?) ... pattern, or replace the delete-all+reinsert approach with a diff-based advance_tips call that only removes stale tips and adds new ones.
